summary: Native in-app reading mode expands FilePreview without recreating viewer; system Back exits expanded view first; PDF one-based current-page and navigation implemented through existing lazy renderer. Recognizes Office/EPUB extensions and MIME for explicit fallback without large binary reads.
proof: Tests committed; no local .NET SDK; CI and DEVICE unverified
competing_prs: PR #893 (beta.43 release metadata) left untouched; PR #886 (PDF extraction) integrated in main, no duplicate ingest.
data_security: No vault schema, permissions, dependencies, signing identity or release files changed. Existing isolated WebView maintained.
limits: Immersive UI and PDF page jumping only; no EPUB, YouTube, browser, annotations, text-layer or full native OS fullscreen. PDF frame allocation and synchronous rendering remain open. EPUB/slides/office readers are not implemented; only correct identification and external fallback.
next: Release by official workflow after integration; no manual merge
